extraction.Name: Albert Emery
extraction.Refused/Protested: Yes, I signed an application for this and gave it to Mr. Whiteis, the Government Farmer at Hamill in 1916.
extraction.Recorded patent: Did not sign a receipt for the patent when it came; delivered in 1916 by the Farmer in Winner, S. D.
extraction.NOTES: Sold land for $6500.00; received $4300.00 in cash and a Chalmer sedan. Was satisfied with the sale. Went to superintendent to ask for patent; superintendent said he would have to get recommendation of district farmer, so he went to Mr. Whiteis, Government Farmer at Hamill. Has wife and child dependent on him. In good health. Sworn before notary public T. O. S.
